desc: Cool, sizable hangout for bar bites and house-brewed beers, plus pub quizzes and stand-up comedy.
addr: Ward No.88, L R Arcade, No.4121, HAL Old Airport Rd, next to The Leela Palace, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: Had a wonderful time at Big Pitcher, Kodihalli! The rooftop seating was definitely the highlight. The cool evening breeze and the beautiful night view made it even more special. Watching the flights glide across the night sky like birds was …

Had a wonderful team lunch at Big Pitcher, Indiranagar with a group of 30+ people. The venue handled our large gathering very well, with comfortable seating and excellent service throughout the event. …

The ambience is really nice, and the overall vibe is pleasant. The staff and service are polite, friendly, and welcoming. While the food is decent, it felt a bit average to me. That said, it’s still a good place to visit for the ambience, relaxed atmosphere, and positive vibes.
